اعلولين (form XII)
# اِعْلَوْلَيْنَ (iʕlawlayna) /iʕ.law.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اُعْلُولِينَ (uʕlūlīna) /uʕ.luː.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# اِعْلَوْلِينَ (iʕlawlīna) /iʕ.law.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
